episodes.title: The Signal
episodes.summary: After their deep-space freighter is damaged, the stranded crew of the Demeter must fight to survive on a beautiful yet dangerous planet.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.summary: As a storm rages, Sam and Ursula set out to find the Demeter, while Azi and Levi seek shelter. Meanwhile, Hollow helps Kamen revisit old memories.

episodes.title: The Wall
episodes.summary: While Ursula bears witness to a transformation, Azi struggles with Levi's ever-changing personality as she tries to survive a deadly stampede.

episodes.title: The Dream
episodes.summary: Alone and in pursuit of Sam, Ursula resorts to desperate measures, while Kamen continues his hunt amid Hollow's demands.

episodes.title: The Demeter
episodes.summary: After an encounter with another survivor, Kamen considers the weight of his actions, while Azi experiences a change of heart.

episodes.title: The Fall
episodes.summary: While Ursula faces an all-too familiar adversary, Azi and Levi find themselves pitted against a formidable new foe.

episodes.title: The Cure
episodes.summary: Facing mounting health issues, Ursula and Azi each find that they are not alone.

episodes.title: The Nest
episodes.summary: While Azi leads Kris, Terrence, and Barry towards her downed ship, Ursula struggles to keep up with an overzealous Sam.

episodes.title: The Mountain
episodes.summary: After reaching an insurmountable obstacle, Azi must learn to trust Kris and Barry. Meanwhile, rough waters test a newly reborn Sam.

episodes.title: The Decision
episodes.summary: In range of the wrecked Demeter, Azi confronts Kris about the ship's remaining survivors, while Sam delivers a devastating truth.

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.summary: As Ursula races to reach the ship, Azi fights to get free and Kamen faces a haunting new vision. Onboard the Demeter, Kris finally meets her match.

episodes.title: The Reunion
episodes.summary: In a bid to save the surviving crew, Azi and Ursula face-off against their greatest threat yet, while a conflicted Barry weighs an important decision.
